owner_rule: 26 Oct 2026 12:32 + 12:36 UTC: three levels; level-2 wording per notification's object and recipient capacity; closure names that object, never the case
wording_status: PROPOSED: Level-2 and Level-3 wording stays PROPOSED until the owner approves; texts are copied from L2-2026-10-26b unless a step is marked REWORDED or PROPOSED-NEW
rules: Level 1 is resolved from CaseRecord.status.code only; master_hint is documentation and is never read by the resolver

A step is COMPLETED only with a recorded event of its completion_event_type (and completion_payload), or of one pattern in completion_any_of, in scope; with completion_target SELF the event must name the object itself; a notification is never its own evidence; an event that matches the step's fail_on is never its completion, so a ballot closed for lack of quorum fails the vote steps (lead ruling L-10); a ballot closed with NO_DECISION is a recorded outcome that completes the vote steps and never an adoption or decision step (lead ruling L-11)
A step is IN_PROGRESS only with a recorded event of its trigger_event_type; otherwise at most PENDING (Layer A) or an expected step (Layer B)
Steps in one alternative_group are mutually exclusive: selecting one never completes the others; unselected alternatives are Layer B ALTERNATIVE or NOT_APPLICABLE
summary5 is true only for genuinely linear objects (W3 3.4: J-DR-AUTHORITY, J-IR-REFERRER); every summary5 journey has structure LINEAR
A witness sees no Level 1; public and scope recipients see Level-1 stage names only (owner decisions); disclosure projection is applied after the view model (W-D2)
Unknown or unsourced values fail closed: governance_status SOURCE_REQUIRED, deadline at null with the reason

field_notes.precondition: Charter field: one step id or null. When several predecessors can each satisfy it (a join after alternatives or a skipped condition), precondition_any_of lists all of them and precondition holds the first (fail-closed for a consumer that reads only precondition)
field_notes.next: Forward successors only (the inverse of precondition, else the next mandatory step); returns are in return_on/returns_to; reopening in lifecycle.events.reopen_on/reopen_to
field_notes.trigger_payload/completion_payload: Payload filter on the event: a scalar must be equal; an array means any of; null inside an array matches an absent key
field_notes.applies_if: Stage or step applicability decided from recorded events: match => applies, excluded_by => NOT_APPLICABLE, neither => unknown (Layer B CONDITIONAL)
field_notes.after_termination: Step still expected after an early termination or cancellation of the object (outcome communication, closure record)
field_notes.v12_stage / v12_ref: Traceability to L2-2026-10-26b (stage number / stage and sub-step); null v12_ref = PROPOSED-NEW step
field_notes.capacity_by_recipient: Level-2 capacity wording per recipient class where one journey serves several recipients (owner rule: wording per object and recipient capacity)
field_notes.completion_any_of / trigger_any_of: Lead ruling L-05 (separate completion events): the step completes (or starts) on any one listed pattern. completion_event_type / completion_payload (trigger_*) repeat the first pattern, so a consumer that reads only those accepts fewer events (fail-closed). Progress rows report the type of the evidence actually matched
field_notes.completion_target: SELF: the completion event must name this procedural object as the completed object (payload.target, else event.object). Set on the closure steps that complete on PROCEDURE_COMPLETED (lead ruling L-05), so the completion of a related object (a grievance, a legal opinion) never closes this path
field_notes.reports_any_of: Assignment: the notice reports any one of the listed events (CF-08: the escalation decision, accepted or rejected); reports_event_type / reports_payload repeat the first

event_types.owner: W-A owns EVENT_TYPES (charter 3.3). Lead ruling L-05 (work/LEAD_notes.md, 27 Oct 2026): W-A adopts the W-C types in adopted_l05 as written, with their purpose, payload and basis as reason and source; five earlier W-C names were replaced by existing types (mapping and counts in work/new_event_types.md)

formal_notices.rule: Lead ruling L-05 item 3: procedural acts issued by their own platform command, recorded as domain events; distinct from notify.* notifications, which carry only a sentence and a link. Service or acknowledgement stays a domain record (L-02)

event_types.communication_events: NOTIFICATION_SENT (with payload.template_code, purpose, subject_object_id) may complete a communication step (notified, reminder sent); under FD-06 and FD-12 it never completes a procedural step and never drives a procedural status

CASE_STATUS_RECORDED.note: W-A payload names (src/domain/concepts.js); transition ids are the V8 transitions (FACT v9_data). The resolver also reads the earlier W-C name transition.

CHAIR_DIRECTION_RECORDED.note: direction values are the charter's; purpose (for MEETING) is PROPOSED.

BALLOT_CLOSED.note: TARGET 3.5; the values of packages/contracts VOTE_RESULTS. NO_QUORUM fails the vote steps (lead ruling L-10). NO_DECISION is a recorded outcome, not a failure: it completes the vote steps and never an adoption or decision step (lead ruling L-11)

LEGAL_OPINION_SUBMITTED.note: W-A payload name (contracts LEGAL_OPINIONS; TARGET 3.6). The resolver also reads the earlier W-C name position.

NOTIFICATION_SENT.note: subject_object_id accepted by L-05 item 4; template_code and purpose per L-05 item 1. Reminder purposes: DEFENCE_DUE_REMINDER and MINUTES_REVIEW_REMINDER (= platform template codes, FACT packages/contracts NOTIFICATION_TEMPLATES), TASK_REMINDER, CONFIDENTIALITY_REMINDER, MEETING_REMINDER (PROPOSED; not built). A reminder step accepts the purpose or the template code (completion_any_of).

REFERRAL_ACCEPTED, REFERRAL_RETURNED, RE.note: Lead ruling L-05: one type per referral decision; round kept. REFERRAL_RETURNED here is the secretary's return for completion (platform RETURNED_FOR_COMPLETION); the sector head's return stays REFERRAL_HEAD_DECIDED{decision: RETURNED} (platform SECTOR_RETURNED). The objection round ends ACCEPTED or REJECTED only (TARGET 3.1 api.decide_referral_escalation). Confirmed by lead ruling L-10: one platform fact maps to one V13 type.

PROCEDURE_COMPLETED.payload: {target: id or {type, id}, reason?, outcomes?, proceeding_type?}
PROCEDURE_COMPLETED.note: Lead ruling L-05: used for the closure of a procedural object and for the conclusion of a grievance proceeding. Closed object = payload.target, else event.object. A grievance completion carries proceeding_type GRIEVANCE (PROPOSAL key; value from platform PROCEEDING_TYPES) and outcomes from platform GRIEVANCE_OUTCOMES.

GRIEVANCE_RECEIVED.note: Lead ruling L-05: also records the registration of the grievance (one recorded event, TARGET 3.8 RECEIVED).

assignments.v13_note: Lead ruling L-05: a reminder is a NOTIFICATION_SENT (payload.purpose CONFIDENTIALITY_REMINDER), a communication event. A notice cannot report or complete on its own sending (a notification is never its own evidence; PC-25 needs a recorded trigger), so this reminder reports its recorded basis STATEMENT_REQUESTED (role WITNESS) (the summons it accompanies) and completes nothing; step 2/1 (reminder sent) is completed by the recorded NOTIFICATION_SENT of the reminder once it is sent, never by its rendering. FD-12: a reminder never completes the task. Confirmed by lead ruling L-10
